---
title: "Analytics modeling, from scratch"
subtitle: "Fifteen lessons in five chapters, each a short essay with figures you can move."
engine: knitr
---

Every lesson starts from a question and builds one modeling idea from the ground up: the problem the method solves, the formula that carries it, and the judgment calls that matter when the math meets messy data. The figures are computed in your browser, so you can drag a point or slide a parameter and watch the answer change. The R that produces every plot is at the end of each lesson.

## Chapters {#chapters}

::: {.chapter-list}

### Sorting and grouping

Putting points into classes when you know the labels, finding groups when you do not, and checking the result honestly.

- [Support vector machines](svm-from-scratch.qmd) The widest street between two classes
- [K nearest neighbours](knn-from-scratch.qmd) A majority vote among the closest points
- [Cross-validation](cross-validation-from-scratch.qmd) Why testing on training data is cheating
- [K-means](kmeans-from-scratch.qmd) Finding groups nobody told you about

### Data over time

Noticing that a process has changed, and forecasting where a series goes next.

- [CUSUM](cusum-from-scratch.qmd) Catching the moment something changed
- [Smoothing, ARIMA and GARCH](time-series-from-scratch.qmd) Level, trend, season and volatility

### Predicting an outcome

Connecting variables to a result, choosing which variables to keep, and the tree-shaped alternative.

- [Linear and logistic regression](regression-from-scratch.qmd) Connecting variables to outcomes
- [LASSO, ridge and stepwise](variable-selection-from-scratch.qmd) Fewer variables, on purpose
- [CART](cart-from-scratch.qmd) If-then rules, grown and pruned

### Preparing the data

Reshaping variables and filling holes before a model ever sees them.

- [PCA and Box-Cox](pca-boxcox-from-scratch.qmd) Reshaping data before you model it
- [Missing data](missing-data-from-scratch.qmd) What to do about the holes

### Experiments and decisions

Collecting data deliberately, simulating what you cannot test, and choosing the best plan under limits.

- [A/B tests, factorials and bandits](doe-from-scratch.qmd) Collecting data deliberately
- [Queues and Markov chains](simulation-markov-from-scratch.qmd) Randomness you can run
- [Linear and integer programs](optimization-from-scratch.qmd) Why formulation is the hard part
- [Beyond the basics](advanced-topics-from-scratch.qmd) Bayesian models, neural nets, boosting and more

:::
